brief: The founder operating system. Eight daily tools for revenue, focus, and freedom — what each is for and how it pays back.

slots.desc1: Central wiki, docs, and databases that keep your entire company aligned.
slots.desc2: Payments, billing, and financial infrastructure that scales from zero to IPO.
slots.desc3: Issue tracking and roadmaps designed for speed without the corporate bloat.
slots.desc4: Collaborative design and prototyping where product and engineering actually meet.
slots.desc5: Frontend cloud deploys that turn every push into a live production URL.

slots.toolTagline: Your company brain, docs, and wiki in one open canvas.
slots.bigStatement: Notion replaces scattered docs and five apps so your team actually finds what they need.
slots.use1Body: Onboard new hires in half the time with living documentation.
slots.use2Body: Link tasks to goals so everyone sees the path to revenue.
slots.use3Body: Track investors, customers, and bugs without paying for extra SaaS bloat.

slots.toolTagline: The payments infrastructure that scales from first dollar to IPO.
slots.bigStatement: Stripe turns payment headaches into revenue momentum with one unified API.
slots.use1Body: Accept cards and wallets in every major market without local entities.
slots.use2Body: Automate invoicing, tax, and retries to quietly reduce monthly churn.
slots.use3Body: Treasury and issuing built for internet businesses straight out of the box.

slots.toolTagline: Issue tracking and project management designed for pure velocity.
slots.bigStatement: Linear keeps product teams in deep focus with keyboard-first speed and zero clutter.
slots.use1Body: Cycle-based roadmapping that respects maker schedules and engineering deep work.
slots.use2Body: Ingest reports from customers into prioritized queues automatically without manual sorting.
slots.use3Body: Connect issues to docs and design mocks so nothing falls through cracks.

slots.toolTagline: Collaborative interface design where product and engineering actually meet.
slots.bigStatement: Figma replaces design handoff with live collaboration so teams ship pixels faster.
slots.use1Body: Design responsive interfaces with components that scale across web and mobile.
slots.use2Body: Inspect CSS and assets without exporting static files or endless Slack threads.
slots.use3Body: Test user flows and pitch investors with realistic demos in one link.

slots.toolTagline: The frontend cloud that turns pushes into production in seconds.
slots.bigStatement: Vercel gives founders enterprise edge with zero DevOps so you ship daily, not quarterly.
slots.use1Body: Every push gets a live preview URL for fast team and client review.
slots.use2Body: Serve dynamic content from over one hundred locations without complex config files.
slots.use3Body: Real Core Web Vitals tracking keeps conversion rates high automatically.

slots.toolTagline: Automation glue that connects your stack and reclaims your calendar.
slots.bigStatement: Zapier deletes repetitive clicks and copy-paste work so founders focus on strategy.
slots.use1Body: Send Stripe sales to Slack and your CRM without writing any code.
slots.use2Body: Auto-publish content across channels when a new blog post goes live.
slots.use3Body: Aggregate metrics into one dashboard email delivered every single morning automatically.

slots.body: Revenue, focus, and freedom are not accidents. They are the output of a deliberate daily stack.
